name: dotnet-msix

Packages .NET desktop apps as MSIX (csproj/WAP, signing, Store, App Installer, bundles, CI/CD). Assumptions: Windows App SDK 1.6+; Windows 10 build 19041+; App Installer auto-update build 1709+; .NET 8.0+.

Modern WinUI 3/Windows App SDK apps package from `.csproj`:
```xml
<WindowsPackageType>MSIX</WindowsPackageType>
<AppxPackageDir>$(SolutionDir)AppPackages\</AppxPackageDir>
<GenerateAppxPackageOnBuild>false</GenerateAppxPackageOnBuild>
```
```text
dotnet publish --configuration Release --runtime win-x64 \
```

For WPF/WinForms, use a Visual Studio “Windows Application Packaging Project” (`.wapproj`), not `Microsoft.NET.Sdk`; reference the desktop project:
```xml
<ProjectReference Include="..\MyWpfApp\MyWpfApp.csproj" />
<DefaultLanguage>en-US</DefaultLanguage>
<AppxPackageDir>$(SolutionDir)AppPackages\</AppxPackageDir>
```
Manifest defines identity, capabilities, assets, `TargetDeviceFamily`, and application visual elements.

All MSIX packages must be signed to install on Windows
